title: GitHub Copilot suggests custom properties definitions
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot can suggest allowed values for repository custom properties, turning AI assistance toward governance metadata that can drive rulesets and policy targeting.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Repository Governance Taxonomy with fixed property names, allowed values, owners, ruleset links, and drift checks.

title: Enforce GitHub Advanced Security configurations
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Enterprise administrators can enforce GitHub Advanced Security configurations across organizations, reducing the chance that local owners bypass enterprise security baselines.
actionable_takeaway: Combine security configuration enforcement with repository properties, rulesets, and agent-generated change gates.

title: SHA-1 in HTTPS on GitHub sunset
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub disabled SHA-1 in HTTPS for github.com and partner CDNs, which can expose outdated clients, proxies, enterprise certificates, or automation environments.
actionable_takeaway: Add TLS/certificate-chain checks to CLI, CI, SDK, and enterprise proxy smoke tests after platform security sunsets.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-9 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds /settings opt-in for context management tools for agents and subagents and fixes scheduled prompt errors, MCP refresh, IDE bridge validation, export paths, cursor behavior, and terminal restoration.
actionable_takeaway: Run an Agent Context Management Gate before adopting the prerelease: settings, failure visibility, MCP reload, path expansion, terminal state, and boundary retention.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0-alpha.8 prerelease
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.0-alpha.8 was published with many assets and digests, but the public release body remains minimal, so it is evidence of an active alpha lane rather than a documented feature change.
actionable_takeaway: Track tag, asset digests, prerelease status, and smoke evidence separately before promoting any alpha build into a default automation base.

title: OpenAI Node 7.16.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The Node SDK release adds per-iterator incoming event limits and fixes malformed WebSocket events, buffering, callback credential scope, Live acknowledgments, and WebSocket error formatting.
actionable_takeaway: Add event-limit, malformed-event, buffering, cancellation, credential-scope, and log-format tests to realtime or Live agent upgrades.

title: OpenAI Python 3.14.1
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The Python SDK release fixes retry-limit validation, preserves application errors, logs only metadata for Live WebSocket diagnostics, skips structured parsing for commentary, and refreshes streaming examples.
actionable_takeaway: Add retry-boundary, stream reuse, metadata-only diagnostics, commentary-output, and async cleanup checks to Python SDK upgrade receipts.

title: Configure cost and quality in Copilot auto model selection
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot auto model selection has efficiency, balance, and intelligence tiers, making model-routing preferences explicit while still letting the platform pick the actual model per prompt.
actionable_takeaway: Record selected tier, actual model, usage, latency, quality result, and rework rate by task class.

title: About Copilot auto model selection
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: The docs clarify that auto model selection evaluates individual prompts and can choose smaller models for simple tasks even under quality-oriented preferences.
actionable_takeaway: Treat tier as policy preference rather than model identity, and keep high-value task acceptance independent from automatic routing.

title: Introducing the Agents API
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: OpenAI presents Agents API as a programmable path that combines Research, Code Interpreter, MCP, image generation, file search, and Codex harness capabilities.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain an Agent API Capability Ledger covering tools, permissions, data boundaries, cost surfaces, proof, and rollback paths.

title: Agents API overview
author: OpenAI Developers
why_it_matters: The overview frames agents as model-plus-tools systems for multi-step work, making tool choice, session boundaries, and safety design part of the implementation contract.
actionable_takeaway: Freeze tools, data retention, session boundaries, and minimum validation evidence before wiring Agents API into production workflows.

title: OpenAI release notes
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: Recent OpenAI release-note signals around Codex policies, audit logs, Admin API groups, and API key lifecycle controls remain important governance context for long-running agent automation.
actionable_takeaway: Keep policy version, audit-log availability, group membership source, API key expiration, and rotation plan in automation receipts.
